attempts.sql:
SELECT s.name AS method_name
FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.kind = 'method'
  AND (s.qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%' OR s.qualname LIKE 'DatabricksDatabase.%')
GROUP BY s.name
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
  AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.qualname LIKE 'DatabricksDatabase.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;

request.question:
Which method names are defined both on SQLDatabase and on DatabricksDatabase?

Requested output columns: method_name (string).

answer.response: The query selects method symbols from the symbols table whose qualified name begins with either 'SQLDatabase.' or 'DatabricksDatabase.', groups them by method name, and retains only those appearing under both class prefixes, indicating methods defined on both SQLDatabase and DatabricksDatabase.
answer.sql_code:
SELECT s.name AS method_name
FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.kind = 'method'
  AND (s.qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%' OR s.qualname LIKE 'DatabricksDatabase.%')
GROUP BY s.name
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
  AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.qualname LIKE 'DatabricksDatabase.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;
